message: The last day of the first term had arrived.

name: Iori
message: 「...So that makes today our last class before summer break.」

name: Iori
message: 「Summer break starts tomorrow, so make sure you all watch your daily habits and don't slack off too much.」
Setsugekka, Momiji, Asahi, Ririmu, Keisetsu. I looked around the classroom at the five of them.
This might be the last time everyone is gathered together in Takamura Class like this.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, everyone, are you listening？」
I called out to them, but there was no answer. Even Ririmu, usually so energetic, was drooping today.

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, may I have a moment?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, go ahead.」

name: Asahi
message: 「There's a rumor going around that you might be leaving during this summer break too, Sensei. Is that true?」
...Leave it to Asahi to catch wind of things so fast.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaat, seriously？！ Nobody told me about this？！」

name: Iori
message: 「It's close, but not quite the truth.」

name: Iori
message: 「I was only ever a temporary teacher sent here on a special assignment. Sooner or later, I was always going to have to return to my company.」

name: Iori
message: 「It was only a question of when, and now there's a chance I'll be recalled to my original unit sometime soon.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If you do return, roughly when would that be?」

name: Iori
message: 「If it happens soon, probably sometime during summer break.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaat—so it's not just Secchan and Keisetsu, even Teach is leaving？！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Takamura Class is gonna get so boring...」
Don't worry, Ririmu. I haven't given up on anything yet.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Hey, Sensei, do you have a minute？」
Momiji signaled me with her eyes.

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course. Go ahead.」
Momiji stood up and walked over to Keisetsu.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, Keisetsu. I have a favor to ask.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Oh? What might that be?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I want to challenge you to a duel.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wh—a duel……！？」
At Momiji's abrupt remark, a confused atmosphere drifts through the classroom.

name: Momiji
message: 「To be exact, with you Kazamine people, though」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「……May I ask for an explanation？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Today might be the last time I see you, so I figured we might as well settle things once and for all」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Between you and me, is there some point of contention？」

name: Momiji
message: 「You're the next head of the Kazamine, and I'm the next head of the Suzakuin. I don't think there's any need to look for a reason to fight, though？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「There is no benefit for me in fighting you as you are now.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, so I'll give you a benefit」

name: Momiji
message: 「If I lose, I'll accept any one demand from the Kazamine」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Any, you say？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Everything possible that the next head, Suzakuin Momiji, can do」
In other words—it was tantamount to saying Momiji would hand over everything within her grasp.
Keisetsu puts on a thoughtful expression.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hold on a second, Momimomi！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A duel with Kei-chan, what does that even mean！？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「……Setsugekka, stay quiet for a bit」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「B-But……」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「What is the method of the duel？」

name: Momiji
message: 「If the Kazamine and the Suzakuin are going to duel, it's Jindou, of course. With any other method, win or lose, nobody would accept it」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, that's true as well.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, Kei-chan isn't in the Martial Arts Division, you know. Even if you fight, it won't even be a match, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I know, right, so you can use clones」
Momiji raises the corner of her mouth and grins.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？ What's a clone？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「So... what is your demand?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I have only one demand.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Kazamine Keisetsu, you will entrust me with the authority to decide what happens to you.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...I see. So that's how it is.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What does that mean？！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「In short, it means the loser has to do one thing—anything—that the winner says.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, hold on... Like I said earlier, Kei-chan, you're not in the Martial Arts Division, so you don't stand a chance in Jindou, right？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You're the one who'll be fighting, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「H-Huuuh？！」
Setsugekka lets her gaze wander back and forth between Momiji and Keisetsu.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh? Wait, so what?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In a duel between Kei-chan and Momimomi, I'm somehow the one fighting, and if I lose, Kei-chan has to do one thing—anything—Momimomi tells her to？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「None of this makes any sense to me？！」
Well, from Setsugekka's point of view, that's basically what it comes down to.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, this isn't a duel between me and Momiji-san. It's a duel to decide the future of Kazamine and Suzakuin.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Conversely, if you win, Kazamine can make Suzakuin accept any one demand we choose.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm... So this is basically a formal challenge from Suzakuin to Kei-chan and me, then.」
Setsugekka finally seems to have caught on.

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...What？」

name: Momiji
message: 「This might be the last time you and I ever get to face each other in Jindou.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The last time...？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even if you come back three years from now, Setsugekka, I don't know if I'll still be doing Jindou by then.」

name: Momiji
message: 「In fact, my father got so swamped with his official duties that he gave up Jindou ages ago.」
Momiji tells Setsugekka straight to her face.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...So what？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka. I want to fight you one more time.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If this is going to be the last time, I definitely don't want to have any regrets.」
A fierce, burning passion dwells in Momiji's eyes.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Well, you've got a point there. If I'm saying goodbye to Momimomi today」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I sure don't want to end things on a loss...！」
As if in response, a fire ignites within Setsugekka as well.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, are you sure about this？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, I'll do it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kazamine's swordsmen don't lose to the likes of Suzakuin.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'll prove it myself—！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Then it's decided.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「—Kazamine accepts this duel from Suzakuin.」
Momiji faces off against the fired-up Setsugekka and Keisetsu.

name: Momiji
message: 「Please come to the outdoor training grounds tonight.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Let's settle things there.」
